title: Pip v. Sky Sister
claim: We both called shotgun for the front seat at exactly the same time when we walked out the door. I think I should get it because I was closer to the car.
relief: I get the front seat today.

filings.author: Sky Sister
filings.body: We both called it at the same time, but I had my hand on the door handle first, so it should be mine.
